title: Restriction of an injective module resolution to an open ringed subspace
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], U an open subspace, and F an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $F\to I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in O_X-modules, then $F|_U\to (I^\bullet)|_U$ is an injective resolution in O_U-modules. In particular, each $I^n|_U$ is injective.
